full_judgment: 5. True, if one looks at the petitions moved on behalf of the judgment debtors certainly there will be no hesitation to infer an adverse presumption against the judgment debtors that their conduct disentitle them to any relief from the Court. There is no doubt that the finalization of the auction sale has been withheld at the instance of the judgment debtors on many occasions. The petitioner moved Writ Petition No. 6793 of 2005 and then Miscellaneous Case No. 24 of 2005. His wife also moved Miscellaneous Case No. 302 of 2008, Writ Petition No. 8242 of 2008 and then the petitioner moved Writ Petition No. 8829 of 2009 against different orders. Another writ petition was also filed by Mahbuba Kabir in 2010. Against the judgments of those matters, they unsuccessfully moved this court, in different civil petitions and miscellaneous petitions.
